import UniformMissingTraceFamily.Main.CountingAndMain.Prelude

# lean-constellation target: `perturbedStarProperPatterns_chooseSum`

For natural numbers n, r, and d and `B : PerturbedStarBlocks n r`, let `w(P) = Nat.choose
(perturbedStarFiller B).card (d + 1 - P.card)`.  Then
`(∑ P ∈ (B.L.powerset.filter (fun Y => Y ≠ B.L)).image (fun Y => {B.a} ∪ B.T ∪ Y), w(P)) + w({B.b} ∪
B.T ∪ B.L) = ∑ P ∈ B.L.powerset.image (fun Y => {B.b} ∪ B.T ∪ Y), w(P)`.
Thus each proper-Y deleted a-pattern has the same weight as its inserted b-pattern, and the full `Y
= B.L` b-pattern is the sole extra insertion.  No r-form bounds are assumed.

- Source `article/sections/02_proof.tex`, lines 37–49

- `Finset.powerset` from `Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset`
- `Nat.choose` from `Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Basic`
- `Main.PerturbedStarCertificates::PerturbedStarBlocks` → `PerturbedStarBlocks` from
  `UniformMissingTraceFamily.Main.PerturbedStarCertificates.Types.PerturbedStarBlocks`
- `Main.PerturbedStarCertificates::perturbedStarFiller` → `perturbedStarFiller` from
  `UniformMissingTraceFamily.Main.PerturbedStarCertificates.Defs.perturbedStarFiller`

## Proof outline

Instantiate
`Main.PerturbedPatternCancellation::perturbedPattern_properWeights_add_full_eq_fullWeights` with the
current `B` and `d`. Its proper-`L` a/T image sum, the full `{B.b} ∪ B.T ∪ B.L` term, the full
b-image sum, and equality direction are exactly the accepted statement, and it requires no `hrd` or
`hrn` hypotheses. Applying that ready proof closes the goal directly; no local injectivity or
cancellation proof is used.

  `perturbedPattern_properWeights_add_full_eq_fullWeights` from `UniformMissingTraceFamily.Main.Pert
  urbedPatternCancellation.Theorems.perturbedPattern_properWeights_add_full_eq_fullWeights`
-/
theorem perturbedStarProperPatterns_chooseSum {n r d : ℕ} (B : PerturbedStarBlocks n r) :
    (∑ P ∈ (B.L.powerset.filter (fun Y => Y ≠ B.L)).image
        (fun Y => {B.a} ∪ B.T ∪ Y),
      Nat.choose (perturbedStarFiller B).card (d + 1 - P.card)) +
        Nat.choose (perturbedStarFiller B).card
          (d + 1 - ({B.b} ∪ B.T ∪ B.L).card) =
      ∑ P ∈ B.L.powerset.image (fun Y => {B.b} ∪ B.T ∪ Y),
        Nat.choose (perturbedStarFiller B).card (d + 1 - P.card) := by
  exact perturbedPattern_properWeights_add_full_eq_fullWeights B d
